about: Which variables a Mail template body references: the rule the Required variable check applies.
A reference is a field of the data the mailer passes (the send's variables, Email, FullName) used in a Go action:
.X and $.X, in plain actions, if and else if conditions, function arguments and pipelines. Inside range and with
bodies .X is the element's field and does not count, $.X does. index . "X", a comment, a string and the text
around the actions do not count, and neither does an action inside an HTML comment (<!-- to the next --> in the text
between actions), which html/template leaves out of the mail. Nothing inside a define counts; a block given dot reads
The same file, byte for byte, is read by skymail-backend (internal/mailer/testdata/referenced-variables.json,
which checks what the server refuses) and skymail-frontend (src/lib/mail-render/testdata/referenced-variables.json,
which checks what the panel shows). Change both copies together.
